field_interpretation.bio18: Three-month precipitation total, mm. Verified against independent sums of monthly CHELSA pr and tas at 16 controls; source long_name says monthly mean, but numeric values match quarter totals.
field_interpretation.bio19: Three-month precipitation total, mm; source long_name says monthly mean. Raw data retained without multiplying by three.
field_interpretation.bio06: Mean daily minimum of the coldest month; NOT an absolute winter minimum.
field_interpretation.hursmean: Mean annual near-surface relative humidity; NOT summer-specific humidity.
field_interpretation.fcf: Annual freeze–thaw transition count; NOT number of frost days.

excluded_fields.kg0: Categorical COG overviews can average class codes; omitted rather than publish ambiguous classes.
excluded_fields.gdd10: Contains negative values and nodata in controls; not needed by this model and omitted.

extremeMinC.dataset: PRISM Climate Group / USDA 2023 PHZM underlying temperature grid
extremeMinC.resampling: Nearest 800 m source pixel at each 10-minute CHELSA cell center; no gap filling or geographic extrapolation
extremeMinC.terms: OSU permits redistribution and alteration with prominent unofficial-map disclaimer and no agency logos. This crop screen is not the official USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map.
extremeMinC.caveats: Mean of annual extremes, not worst historical freeze, event probability, freeze duration or a guarantee of survival. The 1991-2020 baseline excludes February 2021.

global_freeze.source_reduction: Annual minimum of daily minimum 2m air temperature from ERA5-Land
global_freeze.resampling: Nearest native 0.1-degree point at each existing 10-minute climate-cell center; longitude wrapped to 0-360. No spatial gap filling.
global_freeze.missing: Masked/nonfinite/default netCDF fill values outside physical -150 to 80 C range excluded; fields use -32768 packed nodata.
caveats: Reanalysis exposure counts are not mortality or crop-failure probabilities.
Annual minima do not measure freeze duration, timing or acclimation.
0.1 degree data do not resolve orchard cold pools or small-island climate.
Source authors report material regional errors against HadEX3, including Mediterranean TNn MAE about 2.5 C; differing spatial support prevents treating this as an orchard error bar.
CONUS PRISM remains the preferred annual-extreme climatology where present; global ERA5-EX supplies historical tail exposure everywhere available.

crop_scope: Fruit production of cultivated Olea europaea subsp. europaea (oil and table cultivars), excluding African/wild olive occurrence data and non-Olea lookalikes.

score_rules.warm_winter: When cold-quarter mean exceeds 11 C, score cannot exceed the cultivar-unspecific flowering-proxy response.
score_rules.wet_summer: Wetness response below 90 caps score to min(79, response).
score_rules.freeze: Global ERA5-EX 1991-2020 annual TNn mean caps score; CONUS PRISM refines mean where available. No monthly-mean substitute or spatial gap filling.
score_rules.freeze_tail: 1991-2025: >=1 year <=-12.2C caps59; >=20% years <=-7C caps79; >=20% years <=-10C caps39. Require>=30 valid years. Conservative policy choices, not crop-death probabilities.
